job.title: [Post] Commercetools Webflow Migration and Redesign Success ...

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Commercetools Webflow Migration and Redesign Success ...
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of hands-on backend expertise designing, extending, and migrating complex e-commerce architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical proficiency in enterprise platforms, API integration, and headless solutions. I am eager to contribute my proven ability to execute structured platform migrations and data integrations to your engineering initiatives.

bullets.label: API & Headless Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, ensuring robust integration across multi-channel environments.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Migration
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures and designed PIM-to-platform data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to maintain synchronization.

bullets.label: Enterprise Architecture
bullets.text: Built core backend functionality using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders and international technical teams to analyse integration problems, map processes, and translate requirements into stable solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience fits your technical requirements.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, API migration, and integration experience to help your team execute complex digital transformations. My background in delivering scalable backend solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns directly with your engineering goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce migration, Java/Spring backend, and API integration experience to your engineering team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I bring 5+ years of backend e-commerce and API migration experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell. I have a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. My CV and cover letter are ready—let's connect to discuss how I can support your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for [Post] Commercetools Webflow Migration and Redesign Success - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team. With over 5 years of backend and e-commerce experience building robust platforms, API integrations, and data migrations for enterprise clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to add immediate value to your projects.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15.12.2026, and can start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
